rationale: The stock gapped down ~11.6% on earnings and has since recovered significantly from the session low of $185 to $205.45, now sitting at 88.9% of today's range with price well above VWAP ($195.71) and above the 9-EMA ($203.56) — suggesting the initial panic selling has been absorbed. However, the wide bid-ask spread (30 bps), the negative news sentiment despite a beat (unfavorable estimate revisions driving a Sell rating), and the stock's position near the top of a volatile intraday range after a large gap-down create an unfavorable risk/reward in either direction. A long risks a reversal from the upper range, while a short risks continued short-covering momentum; the mechanical setup lacks a clean edge.
